title: Specified dual abelian varieties and pullback classification
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field]. An abelian variety with specified dual datum consists of a group scheme $A/k$ [def-sc-group-scheme] that is an abelian variety [def-sc-abelian-variety], together with a normalized dual Poincare datum $D$ for $A$ [def-sfb-abelian-dual-poincare-datum]. Use the integral group-scheme homomorphisms of [def-sfb-abelian-rational-hom]. Given specified data $D_A,D_B$, a homomorphism $g:D_B\to D_A$ classifies pullback by $f:A\to B$ when $(f\times1)^*P_B\cong(1\times g)^*P_A$ as invertible modules; pullback here is the module inverse image used in the specified dual data [def-pc-module-pullback]. These definitions choose no dual, map, or line bundle from a mere existence assertion.

source.place: Chapter I §8 pp.36–40 (the normalized Poincare datum), §9 opening p.41 (pullback dual homomorphism). The bundle is only a package of these supplied objects; integral and rational homomorphisms are imported from their existing owning node.
